title: Romano confirms Man Utd’s January plans as Sesko & Zirkzee status revealed
text:
Romano confirms Man Utd’s January plans as Sesko & Zirkzee status revealed Scores News Favourites Home Football Predictions Premier League Daily News Roundups Promotions NFL NBA Horse Racing Cricket Golf Darts Romano confirms Man Utd’s January plans as Sesko & Zirkzee status revealed
 Michel Sakr utdreport Michel Sakr Manchester United are planning to reinforce their attack in January regardless of whether they keep Joshua Zirkzee or not.
 The Red Devils have been enduring a miserable campaign, having only earned one win in 10 Premier League games.
 Their 18th place in the table prompted Michael Carrick’s sacking and the subsequent appointment of Mauricio Pochettino.
 However, the new head coach has inherited a plethora of squad headaches from his predecessor, but the management will reportedly intervene in January to try to rectify the situation.
 Romano opens up on Joshua Zirkzee, Sesko & Man Utd’s January plans
 One of the main issues that have hampered the team since the start of the season is the lack of centre-forward options.
 Benjamin Sesko is considered the only natural No.9 in the squad, but he’s been impeded by a shin injury since May. The Slovenian returned to action in August, only to suffer a relapse that will keep him out at least until January .
 While Zirkzee is supposed to be Sesko’s main backup, Carrick snubbed the Dutchman in favour of Benjamin Sesko and Matheus Cunha, so United have been practically playing without a striker since the start of the season.
 Therefore, Fabrizio Romano revealed in the latest video uploaded to his YouTube channel that MUFC will be keen to bolster their attacking ranks in January.
 The Italian journalist expects INEOS to scan the market in search of an affordable solution. Nevertheless, the arrival of a new striker wouldn’t necessarily pave the way for an exit.
 Romano quashes recent rumours linking Sesko to Juventus, insisting the 23-year-old will stay at Old Trafford, as he remains determined to reclaim his role as a key player in the team once he fully recovers from injury.
 On the other hand, the transfer market expert provided less reassuring updates on Zirkzee, whose future remains up in the air. The 25-year-old absolutely loves the club and the supporters, but he’s desperate for additional playing time, having spent the last 16 months on the bench.
 Should Zirkzee leave Man Utd?
 If the Netherlands international decides to leave the club, his most likely destination would be Italy, where he has a queue of admirers beginning with Juventus director Ricky Massara, who tried to bring him to AC Milan and Roma in the past.
 However, Pochettino’s arrival allows Zirkzee to start afresh . So if the former Bologna star manages to elevate his status under the new regime, he wouldn’t have a reason to request an exit.

 In this case, Man Utd would still have to bring in a new striker, as Sesko’s availability for the second half of the season is nowhere near guaranteed. Moreover, Zirkzee is an unorthodox attacker who likes to roam around the pitch, so an out-and-out centre-forward would be required.
 On the other hand, if the Dutch attacker finds himself on the bench over the next 40 days, he should, by all means, push towards the exit door to try and resurrect his playing career.
